newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian SMHL bonds priced, raised to A$180 mln.
newsitem.headline: Australian SMHL bonds priced, raised to A$180 mln.

text.p: Superannuation Members' Home Loans (SMHL) said its Securitisation Fund No.5 bond issue announced last week has been priced at 18 basis points over the bank bill swap rate (BBSW).
The transaction was oversubscribed and was increased to A$180 million from an original A$150 million.
Credit Suisse First Boston was lead manager to the deal with Macquarie Bank as co-manager.
